title: everyrole flow
description: One user flow checked against a deployed app. Pass/fail comes only from `expect`.

name.description: Unique id (lowercase, digits, dashes), used in reports.

title.description: What this test proves, in one plain sentence (e.g. "A paying user can create a new project"). Shown to people; `name` stays the stable id.

start.description: Start URL. `{{BASE_URL}}` is the deploy URL given to the runner.

values.description: Named values the agent may type. `{{secrets.NAME}}` reads env var NAME; secret literals never reach a model.

as.description: Run as a persona (see everyrole.config.json). A string = one persona; an object = one run per persona, each with its own `expect` and optional `expect_denied`.

expect_denied.description: This user type should NOT be able to do the goal. The agent giving up is then expected; pass/fail still comes only from `expect` (which should confirm the refusal).

block_writes.description: Form-only mode: every request that would change data is blocked and recorded. The flow can fill and submit forms safely; use `tried_to_save` to check the submit really fired.

ignore_saves.description: Addresses the page writes to on its own (analytics, metrics); never counted as a save attempt.

expect.description: Deterministic checks; all must pass. The only source of pass/fail.

forbid.description: Words/phrases (whole-word, case-insensitive) the runner refuses to act on.

allowed_hosts.description: Hosts the flow may visit (subdomains included). Empty = start URL's host only.

settle_s.description: After the agent stops, keep re-checking `expect` for up to this many seconds (redirects and async rendering). 0 = judge immediately.

submit_settle_s.description: Form-only tests (block_writes): how long to wait for the page to go quiet before judging. Apps often do slow work after a submit (checking input) before they try to save.

scroll_retries.description: When the agent gives up but the page continues below, scroll down and let it try again, up to this many times (the agent only sees what is on screen).

run_on.description: Environments this flow runs in (matched against --env). Empty = all.

password_field_absent.description: Passes when the page shows no password field: signing in has really finished.

tried_to_save.description: Passes when the page tried to save to an address containing this text, or to any address for "*" (needs block_writes: the request is blocked, so nothing is saved). Background traffic in ignore_saves never counts.
